actions.action: Check soil moisture 2–3 cm deep before watering
Lift plant from decorative pot and inspect roots
If roots are rotten, trim them and repot in fresh well-draining soil in a pot with drainage holes
Set up a pebble tray under the pot
Mist leaves as a short-term fix
Run plant lamp on a consistent 10–12 hour schedule
Water with rainwater, filtered, or distilled water
Let tap water sit out overnight before use (alternative)
Cut off mostly brown or yellow leaves at the base
Watch for new leaves unfurling as a recovery sign
Report watering frequency, water type, and drainage details
